repositories.name: saga-compensation-lab
repositories.description: A Java integration lab for sequential compensable steps against local HTTP services, demonstrating reverse-order compensation and recovery from lost acknowledgments while blocking unresolved outcomes.

repositories.name: scaled-qr-evidence
repositories.description: A bounded dense least-squares library with original scaled column-pivoted Householder QR, limited iterative refinement and numerical diagnostics checked against a native LAPACK SVD oracle.

repositories.name: schema-form-studio
repositories.description: Offline browser studio and Node CLI for a bounded JSON Schema subset. Builds labeled forms, validates instances and exports JSON. Includes explicit unsupported-keyword errors and a finite-state pattern matcher.

repositories.name: scoped-congruence-explanations
repositories.description: A bounded ground-term equality engine with congruence closure, rollback scopes and replayable conflict explanations. A Z3 subprocess independently checks synthetic equality and disequality cases.

repositories.name: selection-bitmap-core
repositories.description: An immutable in-memory selection index for typed columns, evaluating bounded predicate trees with SQL-style true, false and unknown masks. SQLite oracle tests verify null semantics independently of the bitmap implementation.

repositories.name: semver-range-core
repositories.description: Strict semver parsing plus bounded range matching: exact, caret, tilde, comparators and partials. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: sequence-gap-audit
repositories.description: A sequential-event log auditor identifying final gaps, repeated sequence numbers and out-of-order arrivals per stream. It is offline integrity inspection, not a broker consumer or event executor.

repositories.name: set-overlap-join
repositories.description: An exact batch Jaccard-similarity join SDK for pretokenized sets. Original prefix indexing, cardinality filters and integer verification find qualifying pairs while preserving a clear distinction between a complete empty result and an incomplete search.

repositories.name: sftp-generation-publisher
repositories.description: Publish bounded immutable file generations through a real owned OpenSSH SFTP server. Manifest verification, required rename extensions and explicit uncertain receipts protect multi-file reader consistency.

repositories.name: slug-core
repositories.description: URL slug generator: lowercase, Latin transliteration, hyphen-joined, length-capped. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: smtp-mime-capture-lab
repositories.description: An offline SMTP sink and MIME inspection application for deterministic mail-integration tests. It exercises real SMTP transactions, durable local acceptance, recipient rejection and attachment decoding without sending external mail.

repositories.name: sora2-videos-open
repositories.description: Ferramentas abertas para tarefas de vídeo — Núcleo independente para filas de geração, cancelamento e inspeção local de mídia. A demonstração usa adaptadores simulados, não gera vídeo pago automaticamente.

repositories.name: source-map-chain-replay-lab
repositories.description: A headless compiler, bundler and Node replay lab that traces structured stack frames through explicit source-map chains, preserves unmapped locations and checks results against Node's native source-map support.

repositories.name: spatial-loading-studio
repositories.description: A React3D spatial placement editor for bounded boxes, with exact interior-overlap rules, axis-aligned rotations, undo and deterministic plans.

repositories.name: spill-outer-join
repositories.description: A bounded external-sort full outer join for local keyed JSONL streams. It preserves duplicate multiplicity, exposes SQL-like null nonmatching and publishes no result when parsing, Cartesian expansion or disk limits fail.

repositories.name: sqlite-catalog-report
repositories.description: Documente esquemas SQLite em JSON, Markdown e Mermaid, sem exportar registros. Biblioteca e CLI Python, exemplos sintéticos e licença MIT.

repositories.name: sqlite-migration-rehearsal-lab
repositories.description: A disposable SQLite migration rehearsal using a consistent copy, explicit invariants and up/down/up state comparisons, preserving the source and avoiding general SQL-equivalence claims.

repositories.name: sqlite-snapshot-kit
repositories.description: Snapshots consistentes de bancos SQLite — Cria cópias locais consistentes de SQLite, verifica integridade e publica sem sobrescrever destino. Não substitui estratégia completa de backup/recuperação.

repositories.name: srt-caption-check
repositories.description: Validador de legendas SRT — Valida legendas UTF-8 localmente e pode verificar sobreposição temporal. Não traduz, sincroniza áudio ou corrige legendas por conta própria.

repositories.name: srt-shift-core
repositories.description: SRT subtitle shifting: parse, shift by milliseconds, detect overlaps, serialize renumbered. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: sse-stream-inspector
repositories.description: Incremental offline SSE capture inspector in Rust. Handles arbitrary chunk boundaries, event framing, IDs and retry fields, with strict UTF-8 diagnostics and independent retention limits. Includes JSON/text reports and CLI demo.

repositories.name: starship-2050-open
repositories.description: Starship 2050 — jogo de nave no navegador — Jogo arcade com gráficos procedurais, pontuação local e servidor de desenvolvimento sem dependências. Os recursos privados da versão original não fazem parte desta edição.

repositories.name: static-link-audit
repositories.description: An offline auditor of link targets and fragments in a local HTML export. It helps teams check sites before handoff without an external crawler or claims of complete SEO/security auditing.

repositories.name: stone-open
repositories.description: Stone Open — integração de pagamentos em PHP — Código de API/painel e esquema SQL com configuração explícita, webhook autenticado e TOTP local. Documentação e testes offline não autorizam cobranças ou operações reais.

repositories.name: stratified-permutation-mass
repositories.description: An exact combinatorial distribution library for bounded two-label assignments within fixed strata, using dynamic programming and convolution to return integer masses and exact rational tail counts.

repositories.name: stripe-recovery-kit
repositories.description: A local file-recovery library and CLI using mature Reed-Solomon and SHA-256 crates. Bounded stripes, per-block hashes and manifest-last commits demonstrate recovery from missing or corrupted shards without modifying the source set.

repositories.name: studio-69069ea233b84cc7bdbbc06053815f37
repositories.description: Inventário de oficina — demonstração comunitária — Protótipo de catálogo, retirada e devolução de ferramentas com dados fictícios. Tudo acontece no navegador; não é um sistema pronto para produção.

repositories.name: svg-chart-core
repositories.description: Standalone SVG bar/line charts: axes with ticks, labels, title. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: swift-actor-transition-rehearsal
repositories.description: A headless Swift concurrency lab for rehearsing admission, actor reentrancy, cancellation and acknowledged state transitions. Real actors suspend at explicitly owned barriers, while immutable snapshots explain which transitions committed and which became stale or cancelled.

repositories.name: tabular-drift-audit
repositories.description: A bounded offline SDK for comparing reference and current tabular feature snapshots. Exact empirical KS distance, frozen-bin smoothed PSI, categorical Jensen-Shannon divergence and missing/schema changes produce reproducible descriptive evidence without a model or profiling service.

repositories.name: taskgraph-plan
repositories.description: Planejador de tarefas com dependências — Organiza um DAG em ordem topológica, ondas de dependência e caminho crítico. Não executa as tarefas descritas.

repositories.name: temporal-obligation-core
repositories.description: A typed offline temporal-contract SDK for dense Boolean event traces. It evaluates nested bounded obligations with witness explanations while separating false properties, unobserved-future uncertainty and resource-incomplete evaluation.

repositories.name: tenant-policy-lab
repositories.description: A reproducible PostgreSQL lab demonstrating tenant access policies with separate roles, synthetic data and negative read/write tests. It is a bounded RLS example, not a general SaaS security guarantee.

repositories.name: tensor-order-core
repositories.description: A symbolic tensor-contraction planning SDK that computes an exact minimum-multiplication binary contraction tree for a small explicit network subset. Replayable cost receipts and independent numerical examples make planning decisions inspectable without allocating production tensors.

repositories.name: test-shard-plan
repositories.description: A deterministic test-to-worker partition planner using supplied durations and affinity groups. It fills the execution-balancing gap without calculating dependencies or running tests.

repositories.name: toml-subset-core
repositories.description: TOML v1.0 subset parser and canonical serializer: tables, dotted keys, arrays, inline tables. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: toposort-core
repositories.description: Topological sort with deterministic order and cycle witnesses. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: ToTheMoonTokens-open
repositories.description: Laboratório de agentes e simulações offline — API e dashboard para desenvolvimento local com fixtures sintéticas. Trading, carteiras, pagamentos, mainnet e provedores financeiros reais ficam fora desta avaliação.

repositories.name: trace-context-hop-lab
repositories.description: Two local HTTP services and a real OpenTelemetry Collector demonstrate trace parentage, request-context isolation and baggage allowlisting. A headless verifier checks exported OTLP evidence instead of requiring a tracing dashboard.

repositories.name: trace-waterfall-svg
repositories.description: An offline converter of complete trace events into a standalone SVG with process/thread tracks and an explicit time scale. It helps inspect concurrent operations without uploading traces to a service.

repositories.name: transactional-outbox-lab
repositories.description: Python/SQLite transactional outbox lab with atomic domain/event writes, fenced worker leases, retry scheduling and dead letters. Demonstrates at-least-once delivery and consumer deduplication with reproducible offline fault injection.

repositories.name: trilhas-gpx
repositories.description: Analise trilhas GPX locais: distância, elevação, cobertura temporal, CSV e GeoJSON com antimeridiano. Python, documentação em português e licença MIT. LOFRANO TECNOLOGIA.

repositories.name: utc-cron-preview
repositories.description: A deterministic preview of future occurrences for an explicit five-field UTC cron subset. It helps review automations before configuration without installing jobs or executing commands.

repositories.name: uuid-check-core
repositories.description: UUID validation with version/variant reporting and v4 generation. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: verhoeff-core
repositories.description: Verhoeff check digits: catches all single-digit errors and adjacent transpositions. Zero runtime dependencies.

repositories.name: verified-block-delta
repositories.description: A bounded binary delta library using rolling block signatures and SHA-256 confirmation. It emits deterministic copy/literal operations and applies them to a new destination only after base, bounds and target checks pass.

repositories.name: wasm-capability-replay
repositories.description: Compile original WebAssembly fixtures and capture or replay their bounded host capabilities with wazero. Exact call traces, independent arithmetic oracles and explicit interruption outcomes make behavior inspectable.

repositories.name: webhook-signature-lab
repositories.description: An offline library and lab for signing and verifying raw webhook bodies with an explicit HMAC protocol and caller-supplied time. It complements idempotency controls without executing events or claiming provider compatibility.

repositories.name: wheel-record-audit
repositories.description: Auditoria offline de wheels Python: cobertura RECORD, hashes, tamanhos, CRC e identidade selecionada. API e CLI em português, MIT, com limites explícitos.

repositories.name: window-stats-stream
repositories.description: A Java 21 library and CLI for deterministic computation of numerical statistics over tumbling and sliding time windows on event streams. It uses explicit event timestamps, watermark progression to classify late arrivals, Welford's online algorithm for numerically stable variance, and fixed-bucket histograms, operating completely offline.

repositories.name: zanvoria-open
repositories.description: Zanvoria — RPG de criaturas no navegador — Edição de código do jogo com gráficos procedurais, som do navegador e salvamento local. Imagens, vozes e outros recursos sem redistribuição estabelecida foram excluídos.

repositories.name: zellolife-open
repositories.description: ZelloLife — documentos clínicos seguros — Biblioteca reutilizável para renderização e validação de documentos fornecidos pelo chamador. Não inventa achados, não realiza decisão clínica e não abre o SaaS integral.

repositories.name: zig-debuglink-companion-audit
repositories.description: A ELF companion auditor that uses maintained libelf metadata APIs and real GNU objcopy/readelf fixtures to explain whether an explicit .gnu_debuglink reference names the supplied debug file and carries its correct CRC.

repositories.name: zip-manifest-audit
repositories.description: Auditor de manifestos de arquivos ZIP — Inventaria metadados do diretório central de ZIPs sem extrair nem ler os conteúdos dos membros. Relata riscos, mas não certifica a segurança do arquivo.

repositories.name: zonas-geojson
repositories.description: Cruze pontos com áreas GeoJSON: furos, ilhas, fronteiras e sobreposições com predicados exatos. CLI/API Python local, português e MIT — LOFRANO TECNOLOGIA.
